description: End-to-end user flows — api ∩ ui. Personas drive the UI through declared user flows; each flow exercises both the frontend and the backend behind it. Combines the api and ui gate sets plus a flow-coverage gate.

gates.name: e2e.flowsCovered
gates.description: Every declared user flow must have at least one passing end-to-end probe. Numerator: e2e.flowsCovered ; denominator: e2e.flowsDeclared.

gates.name: ui.coverageRatio
gates.description: Methodology Principe 10 — Phase-4 personas drive via browser_* only.

gates.name: api.routes.coverage
gates.description: Every backend route reachable from a declared flow must be probed.
